recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing or separately editing procedureReference would be stale; any future procedure semantics changes should be handled against the active ImagingStudy.procedure element and current R6 Jira decisions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 ImagingStudy request to clarify whether procedureReference meant image acquisition or something else, resolved as changing the definition to "The procedure which this ImagingStudy was part of."
initial_application: Commit 131af0770aa6467c6907c7f556dfd51b8519f05d, matching the Jira applied comment for moehrke_ii_uid, changed the ImagingStudy spreadsheet procedureReference definition to the approved text; R4 historical generated resources also show that wording.
additional_context: procedureReference is no longer an active element. fhir.ini maps ImagingStudy.procedureReference to ImagingStudy.procedure after later ImagingStudy changes such as FHIR-19637, and later R6 decisions FHIR-47666 and FHIR-53025 refined the current procedure element to identify performed Procedure reference(s) during which imaging study data was created.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current build-scope source already defines ImagingStudy.procedure as 0..* Reference(Procedure) with definition "The performed procedure(s) during which the data associated with this imaging study was created" and the notes distinguish requested procedures from performed procedures.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue changed procedureReference/procedureCode into repeatable ImagingStudy.procedure, explaining why the seed's element name is retired.
Applied R6 clarification updated ImagingStudy.procedure wording around procedures during which study data was created.
Applied R6 correction restored ImagingStudy.procedure as the element identifying performed Procedure references.
